name: lians-memory-universal
description: Durable, user-controlled project memory with confirmed deletion.

interface.longDescription: Lians Memory stores project facts and decisions that users explicitly choose to keep, recalls bounded context, and permanently forgets a selected memory only after confirmation. It does not increase OpenAI usage quotas or bypass rate limits.
defaultPrompt: Recall the durable decisions for this project.
Remember this approved project constraint for future work.
Forget a specific stored memory after I confirm.
